name: Theme Toggle & Navigation Verification
description: Verifies login, navbar navigation, and bidirectional theme switching between Cursor Atelier and Auros Liquid Abyss.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login, enter username 'admin' and password 'ChangeMe123!', then click Anmelden
Verify the user is redirected to the dashboard at / and the welcome message 'Willkommen, admin' is visible
Click the 'Auros' theme button in the top navigation bar switcher
Verify the application shifts to the Auros dark theme with deep teal background and glowing accents
Navigate to /konto by clicking the username in the navbar
Verify that the 'Erscheinungsbild & Visuelle Identität' section is displayed with both Cursor and Auros cards
Click on the 'Cursor Atelier' card to switch back to the warm parchment theme
Verify that the theme returns to Cursor Atelier with light parchment canvas and the active badge shows on Cursor Atelier
